cpi.notes: 2025-10 missing at source (BLS did not publish Oct 2025 CPI; FRED shows '.').
cpi.source_title: BLS CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, NSA (CUUR0000SA0); public domain. Spot-checked against BLS historical tables.

rent.source_title: BLS CPI-U rent of primary residence, NSA (CUUR0000SEHA); public domain. Spot-checked against BLS releases.

mort.notes: 1986-12..2016-09 = FRED MORTG monthly (Freddie Mac 30y FRM monthly avg). 2016-10 onward = arithmetic mean of Freddie Mac weekly PMMS 30y FRM rates whose survey date falls in that month (computed by me from weekly values seen on freddiemac.com archive pages). Validation: weekly-derived means for 2016-01..2016-09 match MORTG to within rounding (see check). 2026-10 is PARTIAL (3 weeks: Oct 1, 8, 15). Note freddiemac archive ?year=N parameter is off-by-two (year=2014 shows 2016, 2015 shows 2017, 2016 shows 2018); page headings were verified.
mort.source_title: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey, 30-year fixed, monthly average of weekly rates. Used with attribution.

tbill.source_title: Federal Reserve Board H.15: 3-month Treasury bill, secondary market, monthly average; public domain. Spot-checked against H.15 releases.

gs10.source_title: Federal Reserve Board H.15: 10-year Treasury constant maturity, monthly average; public domain. Spot-checked against H.15 releases.

notes: Home prices: FHFA purchase-only U.S. monthly NSA from 1991-01 (replaced S&P Case-Shiller on 2026-10-22). Other series transcribed 2026-10-22 and spot-checked; cpi & rent 2025-10 not published (interpolated geometrically).

fhfa.source_title: FHFA purchase-only house price index, U.S., monthly, not seasonally adjusted (hpi_master.csv)
fhfa.volK_note: ratio of December-to-December change standard deviations, Case-Shiller National vs FHFA purchase-only, 1992–2025 (correlation 0.97)

sp_ret.source_title: S&P 500 monthly total return, computed from monthly average price plus 1/12 of annual dividends (Robert Shiller's data series, as republished by multpl.com). Index levels are not stored.
